_comment: Street systems (M9–M11). All people, businesses, stations and agencies are fictional. Every Pidgin line is pending native-speaker review (Story Bible §10). Prices in naira (game money).

marshal.name: Road Marshals
lines: Park! Park well! Where your papers?
Oga, wetin you carry for back?
Your tyre don old o. Make we settle am.

agbero.name: Motor Park Union boys
lines: Owo ticket! Drop something for the boys!
Driver, today na ₦300. Market don change.
You no go pay? You wan try us?

task.name: Area Task Force
lines: Task Force! Come down from that bus!
You fit the description o.
Na you dey cause wahala for this area?

passengers.name: The Preacher
lines: Brethren! This bus shall not break down, in Jesus name!
Driver, your hand go dey steady today. Amen?
Who get small offering for the work of God?

passengers.name: The Phone-shouter
lines: HELLO?! I SAY I DEY BUS! BUS!
Tell am say I don reach Oshodi! I never reach o, but tell am!
Network! This network no get sense!

passengers.name: No-change man
lines: Driver, I get only ₦1,000. You get change?
Make I pay you when I reach house?

passengers.name: Drop-me-here
lines: Driver, drop me here! Right here!
Owa o! Owa! Stop!

passengers.name: Market Mama
lines: My son, help me with this basket o.
Take puff-puff, you dey drive well.

passengers.name: Big Man in agbada
lines: Drive smooth. If I no spill my zobo, I go bless you.
Young man, how much be your bus? I fit buy am.

passengers.name: Student
lines: Driver, abeg student fare.
You hear the gist? Them say NEPA go bring light 24 hours. Lie!

passengers.name: Quiet guy in the back
lines: (He keeps looking at everybody's bags.)

stations.name: Gbedu 98.1
lines: Gbedu 98.1: the hottest street jams for your danfo!
Shout out to every conductor wey dey shout 'Oshodi Oke!'
Request line: Mama Nkem says hello to her customers in Oshodi.

stations.name: Highlife Classics 89.5
lines: Highlife Classics: sweet guitar for sweet people.
This one na for the old souls. Dance small.
Coming up: more highlife, no politics.

stations.name: Miracle FM 101.5 · Talk
lines: Caller: 'NEPA took light during my wedding. I want a refund from the sky.'
Host: 'Today's topic: should danfo drivers have their own radio station? Call in!'
Caller: 'The agbero collected ₦300 from my shadow.'
Host: 'If your landlord increased rent again, press 1. Everybody pressed 1.'
Caller: 'I bought fuel for ₦90 a litre in my dream. I woke up crying.'

near_miss: Na road you dey drive or runway?

slogans: Monkey Dey Work, Baboon Dey Chop

home.name: Face-me-I-face-you room
home.note: One room, eight neighbours, one bathroom. Queue at 5am.

home.name: Room and parlour
home.note: Your own parlour! Visitors can sit down now.

home.name: Two-bedroom flat
home.note: Own toilet. Own kitchen. You are now a landlord's favourite tenant.

home.name: Duplex
home.note: Upstairs and downstairs. The whole street knows your name.

daily_events.name: Market fire drill
daily_events.text: Oshodi market fire drill! Carry water buckets to the stalls before the smoke spreads.

daily_events.name: Celebrity convoy
daily_events.text: A celebrity convoy is coming to Lekki! Get there, film it, and don't get in the siren's way.

daily_events.name: District blackout
daily_events.text: NEPA has taken light in a whole district! Carry diesel to three shops so their generators run.

achievements.title: Survived Third Mainland at 5pm
achievements.text: Drive across the bridge between 5 and 6 pm.

achievements.title: Mouth wey sabi
achievements.text: Argue your way through five checkpoints.

achievements.title: Peace maker
achievements.text: Apologise your way out of five wahalas.

achievements.title: Five-star wahala
achievements.text: Reach five stars of Area heat.

achievements.title: Them no see me
achievements.text: Lose the Task Force three times.

achievements.title: Rain no fit stop me
achievements.text: Finish a danfo run in the rain.

achievements.title: Uninvited guest
achievements.text: Crash an owambe and eat the jollof.

achievements.title: Lagos no dey carry last
achievements.text: Finish five daily Lagos Wahala events.
